name: Drop Mentos in Coke
desc:
Drop Mentos in Coke! 🥤

🧠 Take turns dropping Mentos into the coke...but be careful: If it fills too much, it will explode!

💸 The more Mentos you drop without it exploding, the more cash you earn!

😈 Troll other players and unlock cooler Mentos!

💣 Can you handle the pressure?
